description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'FindEvent' that provides a UI for searching and displaying event items with images, dates, and details. It includes import statements for Flutter and a custom animation widget, and constructs UI components such as AppBar, TextField, and a list of event items with images and overlays.

classes.name: FindEvent
classes.description: A StatelessWidget that renders the 'Find Event' page with search functionality and event item listings.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the UI for the FindEvent widget, including app bar, search box, and list of event items.

methods.name: makeItem
methods.description: Creates a widget representing a single event item with image, date, and details.
